label: AP analyst, every country says urgent

taps.question: How clear are you on what is expected of you this week?
How supported do you feel by your manager this week?
How much do you feel part of the team this week?
How well has your training prepared you for your work this week?
How manageable is your workload this week?

conversation.text: You said expectations are unclear. What is happening?

Every country team emails me saying their invoices are urgent, but without a clear priority order I waste time asking around and miss my daily SAP quota. Last Tuesday both Vietnam and Thailand demanded same-day payment, and my lead was unhappy when I picked Vietnam first and paid Thailand late.
What would help you handle urgent invoice requests better?
A simple priority order from my lead or one designated person to decide would help me handle these requests.

Here is what I will tell HR: The employee experiences unclear invoice priorities from country teams, leading to missed daily quotas and conflicts with leadership. [ROLE_CLARITY] "Every country team emails me saying their invoices are urgent, but without a clear priority order I waste time asking around and miss my daily SAP quota."
